OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, with Astra priced 20% lower than GPT-6 Astra

From my own testing, GPT-6.2 Astra upgraded a multimillion-line legacy app with all tests passing after about six hours

OpenAI started a science blog, opening with a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model built with GPT-6 Astra

For developers, GPT-Live-1.1 is available in the API, and the Responses API background mode got discounted two-hour and eight-hour completion windows in public beta
